overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: late-added topics were not anticipated 48 hours out, seating was adequate, and remote-meeting allegations were declined because the meeting was entirely in-person.

allegations.summary: Board added 'reasonably anticipated' topics (more restaurants and two procedure items) to the notice within 48 hours of the June 17 meeting.
